title: Video Editing in DaVinci Resolve
description:
DaVinci Resolve is a professional-grade video editing software used in film, television, and online media production. It combines editing, color correction, audio post-production, visual effects, and motion graphics in one powerful platform. The free version of DaVinci Resolve offers an impressive range of tools that are more than enough for most creative projects. From cutting and trimming to adding transitions, effects, and color grading, the free version supports high-quality workflows without limitations for beginners and intermediate users.

👉 Download DaVinci Resolve

children.title: Basics: open new, import, timeline, export, and save
children.description: In this tutorial, you’ll learn the basics of DaVinci Resolve, a professional video editing software. We’ll cover how to create a new project, import your video recordings, edit using the timeline, and export your finished video.

children.title: Basics: cut and split clips
children.description: In this tutorial, you’ll learn how to cut and split video clips in DaVinci Resolve to trim unwanted parts, rearrange scenes, or create sharper edits in your timeline.

children.title: Basics: apply transitions
children.description: In this tutorial, you’ll learn how to add transitions between video clips in DaVinci Resolve to create smoother and more polished edits.

children.title: Basics: apply effects
children.description: In this tutorial, you’ll learn how to add effects between video clips in DaVinci Resolve to enhance your video with visual styles.
